en-us.otaku_maid_begin: Menus wait on the cafe tables, with the clink of dishes coming from the kitchen. There is time to sit down and choose.
en-us.otaku_maid_join: $joining.name$ takes an empty cafe chair and opens a menu.
en-us.otaku_maid_late: $joining.name$ reaches the cafe a little later and puts their belongings beside a seat.
en-us.otaku_arcade_begin: Rows of cabinets glow, rhythm-game beats mixing with racing sounds. The arcade visit begins.
en-us.otaku_arcade_join: $joining.name$ enters the cabinet area and looks for a game to play.
en-us.otaku_arcade_late: $joining.name$ arrives at the arcade a little later and looks along the glowing screens.
en-us.otaku_manga_begin: New releases fill the display by the entrance. Quiet aisles run between the shelves, with a separate adult section behind the curtain.
en-us.otaku_manga_join: $joining.name$ opens a preview copy at the new-release table.
en-us.otaku_manga_late: $joining.name$ reaches the bookshop a little later and checks the shelf categories by the door.
en-us.otaku_net_read_begin: Manga is sorted on shelves beside the open reading seats. The drink bar is a few steps away. The reading visit begins.
en-us.otaku_net_read_join: $joining.name$ takes a manga volume and sits in the open seating area.
en-us.otaku_net_read_late: $joining.name$ reaches the reading area a little later and quietly pulls out a chair.
en-us.otaku_net_single_begin: A computer and reading lamp wait in the reserved single booth. Closing the door softens the footsteps outside.
en-us.otaku_net_single_join: $joining.name$ enters the reserved single booth and puts down their belongings.
en-us.otaku_net_single_late: $joining.name$ reaches the reserved booth a little later and switches on the reading lamp.
en-us.otaku_net_pair_begin: The pair booth has room for two on its mat, with computers and manga close at hand. The private-room visit begins.
en-us.otaku_net_pair_join: $joining.name$ takes a seat in the reserved pair booth.
en-us.otaku_net_pair_late: $joining.name$ reaches the pair booth a little later and leaves their bag by the door.
en-us.otaku_cosplay_begin: The rental session includes an adventurer costume. The backdrop and self-timer camera are ready for visitors to change and take their own photos.
en-us.otaku_cosplay_join: $joining.name$ arrives at the studio and locates the rental costume and self-timer equipment.
en-us.otaku_cosplay_late: $joining.name$ arrives at the studio a little later and adjusts their costume beside the backdrop.
en-us.otaku_net_overnight_begin: The overnight pack lasts until eight tomorrow morning. A sleeping space is ready in the booth, with a shower at the end of the corridor. Guests can wash and rest at their own pace.
en-us.otaku_net_overnight_join: $joining.name$ enters the overnight booth and sets their belongings beside the sleeping space.
en-us.otaku_net_overnight_late: $joining.name$ reaches the overnight booth a little later and dims the reading lamp.
